rows.finding_text: A new hire who starts before their PPS number issues is placed on emergency tax with up to 40% withheld in the first payslip. The PPS number needs an in-person Intreo appointment (cannot be done fully online) and takes ~2–6 weeks.
rows.official_guidance: All workers in Ireland (EU and non-EU) need a PPS number to work legally and be taxed correctly; apply via MyWelfare.ie plus an in-person identity appointment at an Intreo Centre.
rows.actual_reality: If the PPSN is not in place in time, emergency tax up to 40% is applied, causing acute month-one financial stress; the in-person appointment and postal delivery make 2–6 weeks realistic.
rows.action_required: Book the Intreo appointment and begin the MyWelfare.ie application the day the employee lands, and brief them explicitly on emergency tax so the first payslip isn't a shock.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Ireland inbound); ES→IE anchoring case (Madrid→Dublin, Google, non-EU passport holder). From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: First-time IRP (Irish Residence Permit) registration must be completed within 90 days of arrival, ONLY at the Burgh Quay Registration Office in Dublin regardless of county, by a pre-booked ISD online slot. Fee €300, card payment only (no cash); IRP card is posted ~10–15 working days after approval.
rows.official_guidance: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals staying more than 90 days must register and obtain an Irish Residence Permit.
rows.actual_reality: Registration is Dublin-only (Burgh Quay), appointment slots are the real bottleneck, and the 90-day clock is a hard compliance deadline that is easy to under-plan.
rows.action_required: Book the Burgh Quay ISD slot as early as possible after arrival and treat the 90-day window as a hard deadline; bring the employment permit letter and proof of Irish address.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Ireland inbound), non-EU only. From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: SARP (Special Assignee Relief Programme) exempts 30% of qualifying employment income between €125,000 and €1m from income tax, but the employer must file Form SARP 1A within 90 days of the employee's arrival or the relief is forfeited entirely. 2026 new-entrant salary threshold is €125,000; scheme extended to 31 Dec 2030.
rows.official_guidance: Qualifying assignees may claim SARP relief; the employer files Form SARP 1A.
rows.actual_reality: The 90-day SARP 1A filing window is a hard deadline owned by HR/employer, and missing it forfeits a materially valuable relief — a classic employer-side obligation that is easy to miss.
rows.action_required: Confirm SARP eligibility in week one and file Form SARP 1A within 90 days of arrival.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Ireland inbound), employer obligation. From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify 2026 thresholds before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Irish banks generally require a PPS number plus photo ID and proof of an Irish address dated within 3–6 months to open an account — but housing/utilities take time and the PPS also wants an address, creating a circular dependency in the first weeks. Credit unions accept a wider range of proof-of-address documents.
rows.official_guidance: To open a bank account, provide photo ID, proof of Irish address and (for most banks) a PPS number.
rows.actual_reality: New arrivals hit a chicken-and-egg loop: bank wants proof of address, address/utilities take time, and the PPS also wants an address — stalling salary payment.
rows.action_required: Use an employer or landlord confirmation letter (or open a more flexible credit union account first) to break the loop; sequence PPS, address proof and bank account in parallel.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Ireland inbound). From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Ireland is one of a handful of tapeworm-free territories, so dogs need a vet-administered Echinococcus multilocularis treatment within the required pre-arrival window even for an intra-EU move, plus microchip and a wait of at least 21 days after the primary rabies vaccination. New EU pet-movement rules (EU 2026/131 non-commercial; EU 2026/848 commercial) apply from Oct 2026.
rows.official_guidance: Pets from the EU enter Ireland with a microchip, valid rabies vaccination and an EU Pet Passport (EU resident) or EU Health Certificate (non-EU resident).
rows.actual_reality: Because Ireland is tapeworm-free, dogs additionally need a timed Echinococcus treatment before arrival even from within the EU — an easy-to-miss extra step; the rabies 21-day wait also constrains timing.
rows.action_required: Start the pet timeline early: rabies vaccination ≥21 days before travel and the tapeworm treatment inside the required pre-arrival window; re-verify against the Oct-2026 EU certificate changes.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Ireland inbound); first-class ES→IE category per corridor spec. From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify 2026 certificate format before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Foreign civil documents (marriage, birth, qualifications) typically must be apostilled AND accompanied by a sworn translation (traducción jurada) into Spanish before any Spanish office will accept them for registration.
rows.official_guidance: Foreign documents are accepted for registration and admin in Spain.
rows.actual_reality: In practice offices reject foreign documents that are not apostilled and sworn-translated into Spanish; arranging this from inside Spain adds weeks.
rows.action_required: Apostille and sworn-translate all key civil/qualification documents in the origin country before departure.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Spain inbound); applies to any →ES corridor. From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Empadronamiento (padrón), NIE, opening a bank account and signing a lease are mutually entangled — landlords/banks often want the padrón, the padrón wants a lease or utility bill — and securing a Cita Previa (prior appointment) in central Madrid is frequently the real bottleneck, not the paperwork itself.
rows.official_guidance: Get your NIE, then you can open a bank account and register your address (empadronamiento).
rows.actual_reality: The steps are circular and appointment scarcity (Cita Previa) dominates the timeline; walk-ins are rarely accepted for empadronamiento in Madrid.
rows.action_required: Book the empadronamiento Cita Previa the moment an address is secured and sequence bank + padrón + lease in parallel rather than strictly in order; budget for appointment scarcity.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Spain inbound). From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Legal hiring in Spain is impossible without a Social Security number (NUSS), and for authorisations over six months the non-EU worker must apply for the TIE card within one month of that Social Security registration — a hard, easy-to-miss deadline.
rows.official_guidance: A non-EU employee registers with Social Security and obtains a TIE residence card after arrival.
rows.actual_reality: The TIE must be applied for within one month of Social Security registration; the SSN itself gates legal employment, so timing is tight.
rows.action_required: Employer registers the worker with the TGSS immediately on arrival and diarises the one-month TIE application window.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Spain inbound), non-EU only. From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify before promotion.

rows.finding_text: Eligible inbound workers can elect Spain's Beckham regime (Régimen Especial de Impatriados) for a flat 24% tax on Spanish-source employment income up to €600,000 for the arrival year plus five more years, but the election has a strict application window after starting Social Security and is easily forfeited by default.
rows.official_guidance: New residents are taxed under the standard Spanish IRPF system.
rows.actual_reality: Qualifying impatriates can instead elect the Beckham 24% regime, but the election is time-boxed after Social Security registration and is lost if not applied for in time.
rows.action_required: Flag Beckham eligibility to the employee and their tax adviser in week one and file within the application window.
rows.notes: Destination-side (Spain inbound). From 2026-08-18 destination-profile web research; verify 2026 rules before promotion.
